risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (232.6) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 44 days adds event risk; falling DXY provides modest relief for multinational ITW but insufficient to offset systemic risks.
